purpose: Scope the skeleton-first rebuild against a003. This is a gap inventory, not an accepted anatomical target.
reading: a003 is a diagnostic fit to the existing body, not the final canonical-proportion skeleton.
Only 13/206 bones are currently moderate confidence; 193/206 are low confidence under the fit record.
The tracker statement that 115 proportional placements are low confidence is correct but incomplete as a total: another 78 low-confidence bones are surface-landmark or surface-station driven.
Low confidence does not mean anatomically wrong; it means the current placement method is not sufficient to freeze the canonical skeleton.
Priority 1 retargeting is the distal upper limb/hand and foot because the current mesh proportions are known outliers and those regions are heavily surface-driven.
